name: Machine Triceps Dip
steps: Sit upright against the backrest with your feet planted and grip the handles beside your torso.
Brace your core and keep your elbows tucked close to your sides with your shoulders pressed down.
Press both handles straight downward until your arms are extended and your triceps are firmly contracted.
Allow the handles to rise slowly back to the starting position without letting your shoulders shrug upward.
tips: Keep your wrists aligned with your forearms as you push down.
Stay upright against the backrest to keep emphasis squarely on your triceps.
